name: Shi-ra
source:
A 46 million year old goddess whose existence was erased by human beings in the past. She is the goddess of creation who was born alongside Earth. 

She was worshipped as a god in the past, but no one even knows her name today. She gives the impression of being cold and ruthless, but she also has a sweet side for her companions.

[Translated from [url=http://nakenaiusagi.web.fc2.com/chara0.html]offciial website[/url]]
